description: Stablecoin transaction volume climbed to a record $1.79 trillion in June, surpassing the previous monthly high set in February, according to Visa’s Allium-powered analytics dashboard. The surge came despite the ongoing crypto bear market and reflected growing adoption of stablecoins for payments and cross-border transfers. USDC accounted for the largest share of transaction volume, while Base emerged as the most active blockchain network for stablecoin transactions during the month.
title: Stablecoin Transactions Hit Record  $1.79 Trillion in June, Analytics Show

description: Insta360 X6 has received FCC certification, signalling that the company's next 360-degree action camera could launch soon. According to a report, the camera has also secured approvals in the UAE and India and may debut between late August and September 2026. The X6 is expected to feature a larger CMOS sensor, support 8K 360-degree video recording at 60fps, offer 10-bit colour and improved HDR, and cost between $549 (roughly Rs. 52,300) and $599 (roughly Rs. 57,100).
title: Insta360 X6 Could Launch Soon With Larger Sensor, US FCC Listing Suggests

description: South Africa’s Revenue Service has released draft guidance explaining how cryptocurrencies could be taxed under the country’s existing Income Tax Act. The proposal outlines the tax treatment of crypto trading, swapping, spending, and donations while distinguishing between traders and investors based on their intent. The draft remains open for public consultation until the end of August and, if adopted, could affect millions of crypto holders across South Africa.
title: South Africa Proposes Crypto Tax Guidance Under Existing Framework

description: Two Xiaomi smartphones bearing model numbers 2607DRA18I and 2607DPC18I were reportedly spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification website. The former is said to be associated with the Redmi Note 17, while the 2607DPC18I could be linked with the Poco M8 Plus. The listing hints at an imminent launch in India. Both are expected to share similar specifications. The Redmi Note 17 is expected to arrive with improvements over the  Redmi Note 15
title: Redmi Note 17 and Poco M8 Plus Appear on BIS Certification Database, Might Launch in India Soon: Report

description: Vivo V80 series will be launched in India in the middle of August, a tipster claims. In terms of pricing, the Vivo V80 lineup will reportedly compete with the Oppo Reno 16, which was recently launched in India at a starting price of Rs. 61,999 for the base variant, featuring 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. The Vivo V80 series will reportedly be equipped with an octa core Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset, which also powers the Vivo V70. The rumoured Vivo smartphone lineup is said to sport a 6.59-inch 1.5K display that refreshes at up to 144Hz.
title: Vivo V80 Series Price Range in India, Launch Timeline Tipped Along With Key Specifications, Features

description: Huawei, through X, announced that it will host a product launch event on July 14 to launch the Pura 90 series globally. The launch event, named NowIsYourMoment, will take place in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Huawei launched the Pura 90, Pura 90 Pro, and Pura 90 Pro Max smartphones in the Chinese market in April. They run on the company's in-house Kirin 9000 series chipsets and carry a 6,000mAh battery unit.
title: Huawei Pura 90 Series Global Launch Set for July 14; Pura 90s Pro Max Teased

description: Vivo has introduced the G5i and G5z smartphones in China with identical specifications. Both models feature a 6.75-inch 120Hz LCD screen, Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset, up to 8GB of LPDDR5 RAM and 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. They also include a 50-megapixel rear camera, a 7,200mAh battery with 44W fast charging, stereo speakers, NFC, IP68 and IP69 ratings, and OriginOS 6 based on Android 16. Prices start at CNY 2,199 (roughly Rs. 30,900).
title: Vivo G5i, Vivo G5z Launched With 7,200mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC: Price, Features

description: Nothing Ear 3a has surfaced in a fresh leak ahead of its expected launch. Official-looking renders reveal four colour options, a transparent charging case and an in-ear design with replaceable ear tips. The report also points to 12mm drivers, LDAC and Hi-Res Audio Wireless support, along with touch controls for call recording and audio snapshots. The earbuds are expected to launch at around EUR 99, which is roughly Rs. 10,000, alongside Nothing's next smartphone.
title: Nothing Ear 3a Spotted in Leaked Renders That Leave Little to the Imagination Ahead of Their Debut
Samsung Galaxy A57 5G Battery Test: mAh vs Real-World Usage

description: The Amazon Prime Day Sale in India has entered its last day. This means shoppers have till tonight to purchase all of the products on their wishlist at highly discounted prices. If you've been planning an upgrade, Amazon Prime Day 2026 is offering discounts across several leading AC brands, including Panasonic, LG, Carrier, Blue Star, Samsung, Godrej, Hitachi, and General. Though monsoon may be making its way to several parts of the country, temperatures are still soaring, which means it is still one of the best times to upgrade from your existing AC or buy your first one.
title: Amazon Prime Day Air Conditioner Offers 2026: Best Deals on Carrier, Voltas and More Brands

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 series will be equipped with a different hinge than its predecessor, according to a tipster. The folding and unfolding action on the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra are said to be “more decisive”, the leaker added. This means that users will not be able to easily hold the book-style foldables at particular angles, like they could on the previous generation handset. However, the crease on the two upcoming smartphones is said to be comparable to the Oppo Find N6, which boasts a near-crease-free display.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Series Tipped to Launch With a New Hinge to Minimise Display Crease

description: Apple has resumed support for credit and debit card payments for App Store and iCloud transactions in India. The move marks a return of the payment methods in the country after nearly five years. The Cupertino-based tech giant had removed support for card payments in 2021 after the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) card tokenisation mandate came into effect. Since then, UPI and netbanking have been the existing payment options, alongside prepaid Apple ID balances for purchases and subscriptions.
title: Apple Brings Back Card Payments for App Store and iCloud Transactions in India After Five Years

description: Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026 is entering its final day with discounts on Bluetooth speakers, party speakers and soundbars from brands such as JBL, Sony, boAt, Marshall, Zebronics and Sonos. Prime members can also avail a 10 percent instant discount using eligible SBI and Axis Bank cards, along with additional Amazon Pay cashback on select payment methods. Premium products like the Sonos Arc Ultra and JBL PartyBox 710 headline the offers, alongside several affordable speaker and soundbar deals.
title: Amazon Prime Day Bluetooth and Party Speaker Deals 2026: Best Offers on JBL, Sony and Boat Speakers

description: Redmi is reportedly developing a smartphone with a 7-inch display for a future lineup. A tipster claims the company is also testing a 6.59-inch Pro model. The latest leak builds on earlier reports that mentioned a 7-inch Redmi phone with a 10,000mAh battery, a 2K display and a high refresh rate. The rumoured device could become one of the largest mainstream smartphones if it launches. Similar leaks also suggest Honor is working on larger-screen smartphones.
title: Redmi Said to Be Working on 7-Inch 'Performance' Smartphone

description: Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026 ends at midnight. Before the sale event concludes, you can best deals on refrigerators from reputable brands, like Samsung, Haier, LG, and Bosch. For reference, you can get your hands on a side-by-side Samsung refrigerator with 653L capacity at a discounted price of Rs. 61,740, instead of its listed price of Rs. 1,21,000, during the ongoing Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026. Similarly, LG’s double-door refrigerator, offering a 343L capacity, can be purchased at a relatively low price of Rs. 32,940, which is otherwise listed at Rs. 59,990.
title: Amazon Prime Day Refrigerator Deals 2026: Up to 50% Off Samsung, LG, Bosch and More

description: Huawei Mate XT 2 and Huawei Mate X8 are said to be in the works. The Huawei Mate XT 2 is tipped to feature a new folding design. The Huawei Mate X8 is said to sport an 8.15-inch inner display and a 6.5-inch cover screen. The camera unit of the phone is said to include a 1/1.3-inch primary camera sensor, a periscope sensor, and a new multispectral lens. The battery capacity is said to be more than 6,000mAh.
title: Huawei Mate X8 Display, Camera Details Leaked Online; Mate XT 2 and Mate X8 Said to Launch With Kirin Processor

description: Xiaomi’s Civi series is a lifestyle-oriented smartphone lineup that focuses on delivering a combination of good cameras while retaining slim and attractive designs. In recent months, there have been conflicting reports about the future of the lineup, with leaks alternately suggesting the next-generation model had either been cancelled or was still in development. According to a tipster, Xiaomi has reportedly discontinued the Civi series altogether, and no successor is currently in development.
title: Xiaomi Civi Series Discontinued With No Next-Generation Model Planned, Claims Tipster

description: Amazon Prime Day 2026 is scheduled to end tonight. The ongoing sale offers discounts of up to 80 percent on laptops. Popular models from brands like Acer, Asus, Dell and HP are listed with price cuts in the sale. Buyers can also avail exchange offers and no-cost EMI offers. Further, shoppers with select bank cards can avail up to 10 percent discount on thier purchases.
title: Amazon Prime Day Laptop Deals 2026: Best Deals on HP, Asus, Dell and Acer Laptops for Students

description: Apple could be developing a new smart wearable with the codename B790, as references to the device have reportedly been spotted in an iOS 27 system prompt. The system prompt further reveals that the device will be equipped with two cameras, placed on either side of the user’s head, “left first, right second”. Additionally, the references to “spatial relations”, “visual properties,” and visual identifiers suggest that the upcoming smart wearable from Apple will be capable of spatial imaging and feature visual intelligence. The smart wearable could either be Apple's smart glasses or an AirPods model with cameras.
title: iOS 27 System Prompt Reportedly Hints at Apple’s New Smart Wearable With Two Cameras

description: Bitcoin traded near $63,000 on Monday after spot Bitcoin ETFs snapped a multi-day outflow streak, and improving on-chain indicators strengthened investor sentiment. Major altcoins also advanced as the broader crypto market recovered from last week’s weakness. Analysts, however, cautioned that upcoming US inflation data, Federal Reserve minutes, and resistance near $64,000 could determine whether the rally extends further.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near Two-Week High as Crypto Investor Sentiment Improves

description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy F70 Pro has appeared on the Bluetooth SIG database ahead of its expected launch. The listing confirms the model number SM-E476B/DS and points to dual SIM support and the global 5G variant. The handset was previously spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards website in May. According to a report, it could share most of its hardware with the Galaxy M47 5G, including a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset, 6,000mAh battery and 120Hz Super AMOLED display.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro Bluetooth SIG Listing Suggests Its Launch Might Be Right Around the Corner

description: Specifications of the Vivo X300e have leaked online. This upcoming X300 series phone is tipped to feature a 6.59-inch OLED flat screen with 1.5K resolution. It could run on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and is said to feature a triple rear camera unit headlined by a 50-megapixel primary camera. The Vivo X300e is tipped to carry a 50-megapixel front-facing camera. The handset could debut as the sixth member in the X300 family.
title: Vivo X300e Key Specifications Leaked; Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, 50-Megapixel Zeiss Camera Tipped

description: Apple has been rumoured to expand its next-generation iPhone lineup beyond the traditional launch window of September. While it is widely believed to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra later this year, the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and the iPhone Air successor are slated to arrive in early 2027. Although the tech giant has yet to confirm these plans, renders of the purported iPhone Air 2 have surfaced online. The purported handset, ubiquitously known as the iPhone Air 2, could arrive with a second rear camera, along with an upgraded chipset.
title: iPhone Air 2 Design Leaked in New Renders That Point to Dual 48-Megapixel Cameras

description: The iPhone Ultra, Apple's first foldable smartphone, will not be available for pre-order or go on sale before the fourth quarter of 2026, TF International Security analyst Ming-Chi Kuo claims, citing an industry survey. This year’s iPhone Ultra, which is said to arrive as Apple’s first foldable handset, will also reportedly see limited early production due to “manufacturing challenges”. The analyst predicts that Apple will ship 5,00,000 to 1 million units of the iPhone Ultra in the third quarter of this year, estimated to be 10 percent of the total shipments of 7 to 8 million in the second half of 2026.
title: Apple’s Foldable iPhone to Hit Shelves Later Than Anticipated Due to ‘Manufacturing Challenges’, Analyst Claims

description: Vivo Y500 4G has been launched in select global markets. The new 4G-only Vivo Y series handset is currently available for purchase via the Vivo Pakistan online store. The smartphone is offered in two colour options, namely Midnight Blue and Pearl White. The Vivo Y500 4G is backed by an 8,100mAh battery. It is equipped with a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a rectangular camera module. Moreover, the phone features a 50-megapixel primary rear camera, paired with a 2-megapixel shooter. An octa core Unisoc T7300 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.2GHz, powers the Vivo Y500 4G.
title: Vivo Y500 4G Launched With 8,100mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Motorola has revealed the key specifications of the Moto G77 Power through its India listing ahead of the July 8 launch. The handset will be available in 4GB + 128GB and 8GB + 128GB variants with four Pantone colour options. It will feature a 120Hz LCD panel, MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset, Android 16, a 50-megapixel dual rear camera setup, a 32-megapixel selfie camera, stereo speakers, IP64 protection and a 7,000mAh battery with 30W charging support.
title: Moto G77 Power Listed on Company's Website With Key Specifications Before July 8 Debut

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 series and Galaxy Flip 8 are likely to be launched later this month. While the launch date remains a mystery, the price details of the foldable family and the Galaxy Watch 9 have leaked online. Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 is said to start at EUR 1,999 (roughly Rs. 2,17,000) for the 256GB model. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra will reportedly have a price tag of Rs. 2,199 (roughly Rs. 2,40,000) with the same storage capacity.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Fold 8 Ultra, Galaxy Flip 8, Watch 9 Prices Leaked Online Ahead of Launch

description: The iPhone 18 series is expected to launch later this year, and rumours so far suggest the lineup could include the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra. Meanwhile, the vanilla iPhone 18 is slated to debut next year. According to an analyst, the standard model will receive a modest RAM upgrade over the current iPhone 17 to support Apple Intelligence features better. More RAM is expected on the iPhone 18e, too.
title: iPhone 18, iPhone 18e Tipped to Get 9GB RAM Upgrade for Apple Intelligence; Pro Models May Stick With 12GB

description: The Xiaomi 18 series is rumoured to have been in development for quite some time. Recent leaks have revealed key display and camera upgrades expected on the Xiaomi 18 Pro. Now, fresh details about the rumoured Xiaomi 18 Pro Max have surfaced online. A new leak from a tipster suggests that the purported handset could bring notable improvements in imaging, battery capacity, and display design over its predecessor. It is expected to feature a dual 200-megapixel camera setup and an 8,500mAh battery.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Camera, Display, Battery Details Tipped; May Get 8,500mAh Battery, 200-Megapixel Cameras
